newsitem.title: UK: LIG says H1 dividend rise reflects optimism.
newsitem.headline: LIG says H1 dividend rise reflects optimism.

text.p: British-based healthcare group London International Group Plc (LIG) said on Thursday that its six-month dividend soared by 40 percent to 0.7 pence per share reflecting its optimism over its long-term operations.
"Progress with integration of all our acquisitions is encouraging and the increase in the interim dividend reflects our confidence in the longer term," Nick Hodges, LIG's Chief Executive, said.
LIG said its pretax profit before exceptional items rose by 46 percent to 9.5 million stg in the six months ended September 30, while its earnings per share rose 35 percent to 1.93 pence.
The group's overall sales went up five percent to 158.1 million stg, while turnover in its core business rose by 12 percent to 112.7 million stg.
At 0814 GMT LIG shares were indicated at an unchanged 169 pence.
